ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.6:0.4 ratio of low-intensity (dark) pixels concentrated in the central and leading-edge regions versus high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central axis and interior regions exhibit solid low-intensity pigmentation. Lateral regions (outer 40% of each lobe) feature high-intensity white blobs. Left lobe white field contains dark punctate mottling. Right lobe white field contains a prominent, low-intensity horizontal linear streak.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees; central point is partially obscured by water spray/surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the distal 50% of both lobes, transitioning to smoother contours toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature from the notch toward the sharp, upward-tapering lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark horizontal linear streak is detected on the white field of the right lobe; several shorter, diagonal linear disruptions are visible on the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle clusters on distal tips and dark linear rake-like abrasions on ventral surface areas.
